items.name: Cadiz Speedcubing Open 2025
items.information: #### Welcome to the first ever WCA competition in Cadiz City. Whether you’re a first-time competitor or a seasoned cuber, this is your chance to join the growing speedcubing community of Negros Occidental, meet fellow cubers, and showcase your skills on the official stage. **Important Reminders:** - Competitors (or guardians for minors) must agree that the Organizers, PCA, and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage, or loss resulting from participation in this event. - Please read the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**. - Check the **Competitor Guide and Updates** tab for announcements and changes. - See the **Events** and **Schedules** tabs for more details.

items.name: Flushing Glow Autumn AM 2025
items.information: This is a series competition with Flushing Glow Autumn PM 2025. You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for [Flushing Glow Autumn PM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FlushingGlowAutumnPM2025) , your registration for this competition will be rejected. This competition is sponsored by the Glow Cultural Center, which provides cultural, wellness, and youth development programs and serves as a hub for community activity. Glow aims to serve the multi-cultural population of the community, including but not limited to the under-served new immigrant, low-income households residing in Flushing and nearby communities. All proceeds from this competition will go to the Glow Cultural Center. items.name: VR Bengaluru Cube Open A 2025

venue.name: VR Bengaluru
venue.address: Whitefield Main Road, Devasandra Industrial Estate, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048

items.information: Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website.** ​ * All participants must be present for the entire duration of the competition irrespective of the number of events. ​ * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. * Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue. ​ * We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called. ​ * Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations. ​ * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. ​ * Participants must bring their own cubes.
